workerResult.summary: Moon Pantry — a lunar recipe box for midnight cooks, built in a bold Memphis aesthetic (cream paper, clashing neon accents, heavy black outlines, hard offset shadows, wavy underlines, marquee ticker, sticker badges, seeded confetti/starfield canvas). Recipe phases: 8 lunar phases each spotlight recipes, with an astronomically-correct waxing/waning moon. Pantry stock: tick ingredients, live cookability meter (have/missing + %), search, stock-basics, stock-all, all persisted to localStorage. Midnight mode: deep-night palette, twinkling starfield canvas, midnight-only recipes sorted first, auto-activates 11PM-5AM. No images — CSS/canvas only. Fully keyboard-accessible, prefers-reduced-motion respected, responsive down to 375px. Build passes, preview serves real content, relative ./assets paths for subpath hosting. Reviewer fixes applied: midnight theme now on <html> so canvas reads correct bg, persisted phase/pantry validated against crash-on-bad-value, and purple accent contrast improved to dark-on-purple.
